atomic_facts.fact: Albert Saniger's full legal name is Alberto Saniger Mantinan.
Alberto Saniger Mantinan is also known as (a/k/a) Albert Saniger.
Albert Saniger is the founder of Nate, Inc.
Albert Saniger is the former CEO of Nate, Inc.
In April 2025, the U.S. Attorney's Office for the Southern District of New York initiated a criminal action (indictment) against Albert Saniger.
In April 2025, the SEC filed a parallel civil action against Albert Saniger.
The criminal charges against Saniger included securities fraud.
The SEC filed a civil complaint against Albert Saniger.
The SEC complaint alleges Saniger fraudulently solicited investments in Nate.
The alleged fraudulent solicitation was based on false and misleading statements about Nate's use of AI.
The SEC complaint constitutes a regulatory enforcement action against Albert Saniger.
Nate, Inc. formally dissolved in January 2023.
There is no evidence of personal bankruptcy or insolvency by Albert Saniger as of September 2026.
There is no evidence of a civil judgment exceeding $1 million against Albert Saniger as of September 2026.
